name: University of Melbourne Science Access Scholarship
summary: A $6,500 yearly living allowance for Access Melbourne students starting a Bachelor of Science.
key: $6,500 a year for four years, up to $32,500, about 10 offered.
who: Australian or NZ citizen or Australian permanent visa holder.
Completed Year 12 or IB in Australia and applied for the Bachelor of Science.
how: Automatic consideration when you apply for admission and submit a VTAC Equity Schemes and scholarships application.
